notes: Each eval runs on a fresh copy of evals/fixture (a Go module with seeded problems, see expected.json). Score a run with: python3 skills/evals/score.py <report>.json

evals.name: decisions-full-module
evals.prompt: Проверь этот Go-модуль на соответствие Google Go Style Decisions и дай отчёт со ссылками на разделы гайда.
evals.expected_output: Report under .go-style/reports with findings linked to google-decisions sections; recall of the google-decisions items in expected.json; no findings on the negative items.

evals.name: uber-full-module
evals.expected_output: Report linked to the Uber guide; conflicts with Google flagged as optional; recall of the uber items.

evals.name: all-guides-full-module
evals.prompt: сделай ревью кода этого модуля по всем гайдам (google, effective go, uber)
evals.expected_output: One combined report; each problem reported once under the highest-priority guide with see-also links; Uber advice that contradicts Google not reported.

evals.name: effective-full-module
evals.prompt: Насколько этот код идиоматичен с точки зрения Effective Go?
evals.expected_output: Report linked to Effective Go sections; recall of the effective items.

evals.name: guide-principles
evals.expected_output: Principle-level findings (least mechanism in util.Sum, clarity) with links to the core guide; mechanical findings from gofmt/var-naming.

evals.name: practices-full-module
evals.prompt: Пройдись по модулю с Google Go Best Practices: обработка ошибок, глобальное состояние, тесты.
evals.expected_output: Findings mostly 'consider', grouped by theme; recall of google-practices items.

evals.name: diff-mode
evals.prompt: проверь только мои изменения по гайдам
evals.expected_output: Only findings on the lines changed since the base commit (the fixture copy is committed first, then one file is edited).
